aiSection.title: AI-Powered Assistants
aiSection.subtitle: Smart bots that help you with everything
aiSection.desc: Our platform integrates advanced AI assistants into every aspect of your experience. Whether you're exploring events, building your brand, or connecting with people — intelligent bots are always ready to guide, recommend, and optimize.
aiSection.contextAwareDesc: AI chat helpers available on every page, understanding your current context
aiSection.eventRecDesc: AI picks the best events based on your interests and activity
aiSection.smartSearchDesc: Find people, partners, and communities with intelligent matching
aiSection.contentModDesc: Automatic review of photos, descriptions, and user-generated content
aiSection.insightsDesc: Tailored suggestions based on your behavior and preferences
aiSection.brandOptDesc: AI helps you craft better profiles, brands, and event descriptions

walletSection.title: Web3 Custody Wallet
walletSection.subtitle: Secure on-chain payments powered by Polygon
walletSection.desc: Every user gets a secure custodial wallet on the Polygon network. Pay for events, transfer funds to other members, and manage your assets — all within the platform. No external wallets or complex setups required.
walletSection.eventPaymentsDesc: Pay for tickets and registrations with USDT directly from your wallet
walletSection.p2pDesc: Send funds to any platform member instantly via chat
walletSection.twoFaDesc: Every transaction confirmed with Google Authenticator OTP
walletSection.lowCostDesc: Polygon network ensures minimal fees and fast confirmations
walletSection.qrDepositsDesc: Top up your wallet easily by scanning a QR code
walletSection.encryptedDesc: Private keys are encrypted and stored securely on our infrastructure

security.title: Security First
security.subtitle: Your data, your control
security.desc: We take security seriously. All connections are protected with HTTPS, authentication uses JWT tokens stored in secure HttpOnly cookies, wallet operations require 2FA verification, and all sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
